Title: Azure China cloud integration for Azure Stack

Body.Content:
Azure Stack is integrated with the Azure China cloud, enabling connections to identity, subscription, registration, billing, backup/DR, and Azure Marketplace. Azure Stack unlocks a wide range of hybrid cloud use cases, such as edge and disconnected, regulatory scenarios.

Learn More about Azure Stack.
Learn More about the responsibilities of being an Azure Stack operator, such as billing and syndication
